samples.text: Readability is the ease with which a reader can understand a written text. In natural language, the readability of text depends on its content, specifically the complexity of its vocabulary and syntax. The formal definition of readability has been studied extensively, and a number of formulas have been proposed to quantify it. Because comprehension is a cognitive process, no single formula captures every aspect of it. Nevertheless, simple measures such as average sentence length and average syllable count correlate remarkably well with observed reading difficulty across many populations.
